greetings.text: Now then! What's this? Ye'll not be wanting anything on my land without a by-your-leave.
Mind the dogs. They'll not harm ye if ye keep your hands to yourself.
Eh? Friends, are ye? Well, come in then. Kettle's on.

farewells.text: Off ye go, then. Mind the road.
Good day. And tell your folk to knock first.

smalltalk.text: Best mushrooms in the Shire, I grow. Folks used to creep in and steal 'em. Not much of that now, with the dogs about.
The Marish is a good country. A bit damp, mind, but good.
Time was, nobody locked a door in the Shire. Now I'd bar the barn if I could.

maggot_dogs_and_rider.text: A black rider came to my gate this very morning, asking for Baggins in a voice like a dry hinge. Sent him packing. The dogs wouldn't stop howling till noon.

frodo_sold_bag_end.text: Mr. Baggins selling Bag End? Well, I never. Not my business. But I'd not like to be a Gamgee this week.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Strange folk come and go on the East Road these years. I keep to my own field and my own gate.
